keyword.description: Match title and section text, case-insensitively. Separate words are combined with AND, so `deploy token` finds a topic whose title and section mention both.

days.description: Only topics marked within the last N days (1 = the last 24 hours).

session.description: Restrict to one conversation id. Hidden conversations are excluded unless one is named explicitly.

limit.description: Keep only the newest N matching topics.

topic_id.description: One topic's id, as printed in the `topic_id` column of a `sections` result. Required for `include: "full"`; with `sections` or `excerpt` it narrows the result to that one topic.

include.description: How much to return. `sections` (default) lists rows. `excerpt` adds the first and last few cleaned messages of each matching topic, at most 1,000 characters per topic. `full` prints one topic's cleaned messages, addressed by `topic_id`, at most 8,000 characters — read the excerpt first, then ask for the one topic you need.
